title: Earthy Aerated Australian Ground Nut Fried Rice
description: A lacto-vegetarian-friendly, aerated midnight-craving Australian dish made with ground nut oil and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of ground nut oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 small onion, diced, and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add 2 cloves of garlic, minced, and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of mixed mushrooms, sliced, and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add 2 cups of diced bell peppers and cook until they start to soften.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add 2 tablespoons of ground nut oil to the empty side of the pan and pour in 2 eggs, beaten.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then mix with the vegetables.
Add 400g of fry-grind-rice-khao-khua to the pan and stir-fry for about 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
